Suggested_Correction: For the Law Drafting Division / policy authority to determine whether the TC wording 「不足一年」 should be aligned with the EN “not more than one year” (e.g. 「不超過一年」). No correction is proposed unilaterally in this submission.
Issue_Description: EN “not more than one year” (≤ 1 year, inclusive of exactly one year) vs TC “不足一年” (< 1 year, exclusive of exactly one year). The two versions differ by exactly the one-year endpoint; the TC wording is stricter than the EN wording (and stricter than the Basel standard, which expresses the same ≤ 1-year boundary as “less than or equal to one year”). Affects only receivables whose original maturity is exactly one year.

Current_Text_Excerpt: (b)(a)款提述的責任已按照本條例履行。
Counterpart_Text_Excerpt: (b) the duty referred to in paragraph (a) has been performed in accordance with this Ordinance.
Suggested_Correction: For legislative amendment (not editorial correction of HKeL): “(b)(a)段提述的責任已按照本條例履行。” — replace “款” with “段”.
Issue_Description: TC writes “(a)款” but (a) is a <paragraph> in both XML versions; EN correctly says “the duty referred to in paragraph (a)”. The referent is unambiguous. This wording is present in the Ordinance as enacted (Ordinance No. 5 of 2002, gazetted text), not an HKeL transcription or digitisation error: the same Schedule, Pt. 1, s. 79(c) uses “段” for a comparable reference. Correction therefore requires legislative amendment, not editorial correction of HKeL.
